# TeslaUSB Enhanced v1.2.0-rc.5

This is an **unofficial prerelease** of TeslaUSB Enhanced for the Raspberry Pi
Zero 2 W. Back up existing configuration, keys, and recordings before flashing
it. This image must be built from the rc.5 source; the published rc.4 image does
not contain the repairs below.

## First-boot repairs

- The image build removes the standalone Raspberry Pi OS `resize` token while
  preserving the generated `root=PARTUUID=...` and unrelated boot options.
- The build and post-build verifier require exactly one `rootwait` and one
  `modules-load` token whose module list begins with `dwc2,g_ether`, while
  preserving deduplicated extra modules. Multiline or malformed boot command
  lines are rejected.
- Transaction recovery is installed only after TeslaUSB has created and
  mounted `/mutable`, avoiding the rc.4 first-setup ordering failure.
- Normal read-only boots no longer print harmless boot-log write errors, and a
  failed one-time repair hook is retained for retry.

## Configuration and storage safety

- The offline wizard asks for the card's advertised decimal capacity and
  rejects a camera image above the conservative ceiling for that card.
- `CAM_SIZE` uses an explicit `G` suffix denoting GiB. Unitless values,
  unsupported units, undersized images, arithmetic overflow, and impossible
  allocations fail before setup.
- Wizard text is ASCII-safe so locally opened copies do not display corrupted
  punctuation when a browser or filesystem supplies the wrong encoding.

## Encrypted recording boundary

- An empty `TeslaCam/EncryptedClips` placeholder no longer causes a false
  encrypted-recording warning.
- Any entry, hidden entry, directory, link, non-directory object, or unknown
  inspection state remains protected without reading encrypted clip contents.
- Unknown inspection results remove stale dashboard status so an old clear
  result cannot remain visible while automation is failing closed.

## Image and hardware

- Built from 64-bit Raspberry Pi OS Lite (Debian Trixie) for arm64.
- Primary hardware target: Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W.
- A high-endurance microSD card of at least 64 GB is required; the wizard and
  README provide conservative `CAM_SIZE` ceilings for common card capacities.
- Connect the vehicle to the Zero 2 W's USB **data/OTG** port, not its
  power-only port.

## Validation boundary

The release pipeline performs offline filesystem, boot-command-line,
configuration, source-manifest, credential-absence, and package checks before
publishing the compressed image and its checksum and provenance assets.
Physical Zero 2 W boot, Wi-Fi, USB enumeration, vehicle recording, archive,
reboot, and power-cycle testing remain required for full hardware validation.
